# Know whether WFS or shipping it yourself leaves more — and whether matching still pays.

> Free Walmart Marketplace calculator: compare WFS vs seller-fulfilled profit, apply the referral-fee floor, and see whether matching a lower price still leaves money after Buy Box take.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
